name: plaiiin-lamps
description: Control, compose for and manage PlaiiinLight lamps on your local network.

interface.shortDescription: Control and compose for your lamps
interface.longDescription: Work with the PlaiiinLight lamps on your local network: power, colour and brightness, light effects you describe and preview, pictures, scenes, and firmware updates. Runs on your Mac and talks to the lamps directly; you decide per lamp what the assistant may do.
